Game Overview

Royal Rush is a casual game built around embark on a daring quest through a whimsical world with Milo to rescue Nova. Dodge treacherous foes and navigate perilous platforms, using clever jumps and power-ups to overcome formidable obstacles. Discover hidden crystals in this thrilling fantasy adventure, where every leap counts and bravery is rewarded.
